title: Create a factual recap evidence ledger
note: Search by surname, tournament and date, then require exactly one match for both players. maxItems caps candidate matches, not games or points. Inspect saved candidates if selection fails.
goal: Explain the result and up to three supported pressure moments in the selected match. Use player names, set and game numbers for readers; retain source URLs and event IDs as receipts. Say when fewer than three moments are supported. Do not infer emotions or causes.
